Define a cross-node Evidence Capsule protocol for browser results: immutable capsule ID, source URL/domain, capture time, tab/session identifier (pseudonymous), selected text/DOM region, content hash, redaction map, and confidence. Capsules are the only input exposed to synthesis and Mac actions; every derived summary/action receipt links back to capsule IDs. Add TTL and revocation so deleting a source removes downstream display while preserving an audit tombstone.
entries.note: local-agent/evidenceCapsules.js: every browser reading becomes an immutable, content-addressed capsule (source URL/host, region, capture time, pseudonymous observer, content hash, redaction map, confidence with reasons, TTL). Ids are sha1 over (source, region, observer-session, contentHash) and deliberately NOT over capture time, so a watch polling an unchanged page all day produces one capsule, not ninety-six — same derivation as actionReceipts.actionIdFor. Minted at ONE chokepoint, computerControl.runBrowserAction, after the extension answers and never before; a mint that throws is swallowed onto the result. Everything downstream links the id it was given rather than minting its own (browserPage read/snapshot, pageWatch reports, browserInspect citations and act records, originFanOut). Receipts carry evidence.capsuleIds with a source label — 'result' (recorded at the extension boundary), 'declared' (the caller tagged the action), or 'unlinked' — and the journal derives evidenced/unlinked counts on read. Redaction map is built entirely from redaction.js (no second pattern set) with per-segment offsets; secrets are withheld from the stored body and verified withheld, personal data is flagged and kept. NO GATE: nothing here can refuse, delay, or alter a browser action. TTL withholds the body on read (presentCapsule); revocation nulls the content and leaves a permanent tombstone carrying the contentHash; sweep retires long-expired bodies. No code path removes a row — the three writers are push, null-content, null-content. Re-reading byte-identical content after a revocation returns the tombstone rather than resurrecting it, which is how deletion propagates; a page that CHANGED mints live evidence again, so no source is ever blacklisted. Verified live on a throwaway agent on :8137 (owner's :8000 untouched): API key withheld from the body, URL query token dropped, session name and tab number absent from the JSON, redaction offsets addressing the stored body, /execute -> receipt -> /journal -> /evidence citedBy join, revoke -> content null + tombstone with hash + row still on disk, re-read collapsing onto the revoked id. 888/888 tests, 32 in evidenceCapsules.test.js. NOT COVERED, and it is not complete coverage: a capsule is not a permission boundary — synthesis is not forced to read through one, so 'capsules are the ONLY input' is NOT enforced; what is enforced is that the reading was recorded and that every receipt says whether it was linked. cloud-relay/serverBrowser.js readPublicPage mints nothing when the relay itself is the caller (openaiRealtimeVoice read_web_page, scheduler.js) because that store does not exist in the relay process; originFanOut.js calls the same reader from the Mac and does mint. browser_click/type/select/press_key carry no page content. browser_capture stores an empty body — the screenshot bytes are deliberately never kept. Mac actions link evidence only when the caller tags them, so an untagged write_file whose content came off a logged-in page shows as 'unlinked' rather than being attributed to a nearby capsule. screenCapture and computerUse vision pixels are a separate provenance problem and are not capsuled.

entries.summary: Add a local-first evidence-bundle pipeline shared by the browser and Mac surfaces. It should accept a set of browser page captures and local files, normalize them without rewriting originals, compute SHA-256 hashes and capture metadata, detect likely secrets/PII, generate a redacted review copy plus an encrypted manifest, and expose a review/edit/export state machine. The relay receives only the task description and derived findings unless the owner explicitly chooses to export raw material.

Add a Cross-Source Reconciliation job type between browserBridge and the Mac agent. It accepts two source descriptors (authenticated tab extraction recipe and local file/range), emits normalized typed records with provenance, joins on declared or inferred keys, computes materiality/confidence, and writes a review artifact containing before/after values and an unapplied patch. Browser extraction must carry deviceId/tabId, URL, title, extraction timestamp, selector/region, and content hash; local extraction must carry file path, sheet/range or note heading, mtime, and hash. Reuse the existing job/receipt records and browser session binding, but add a deterministic dry-run result and resume cursor so a dropped extension does not lose the diff.

Add a privacy-audit pipeline that runs as a durable, scoped manifest job: browser account adapters emit typed data-category/retention/export/delete evidence; a Mac-local scanner emits metadata, hashes, path, app, and mtime without file contents; a correlator joins them, assigns confidence and retention recommendations, and renders an owner-reviewable report with unsent request drafts. Give every source a revocable scope token, per-item retention, and a one-click purge of the audit artifact itself.

Unify browser device health with the fleet device registry instead of exposing two contradictory truths. The browser heartbeat should publish a signed presence record (extensionId, browser/version, tabCount, active tab hash, lastSeenAt, monotonic sequence); /browser/status and the generic device list should derive the same state using one freshness window and explicit states online, stale, offline, or registered-never-seen. Include a discrepancy diagnostic when registries disagree, and pass that typed health fact into mac-planner/relay recovery cards. A stale device must not be eligible as a command target even if the generic registry says online.

Create a device-local 'private join' broker on the Mac bridge. Browser and Mac extractors submit separately scoped, typed records tagged with a one-time job key; the broker performs normalization, matching, and discrepancy detection locally, then emits only a redacted result containing mismatch IDs, confidence, and provenance pointers. The relay and pendant never receive raw page text, screenshots, filenames, or account identifiers. Add schema negotiation, field-level redaction, TTL deletion, and receipts proving which fields were compared.

Create a local authenticated-page evidence compiler between the Safari bridge and the planner. It should accept the active tab’s DOM/text, identify obligation-like regions (dates, amounts, renewal/cancellation language, required actions), produce a compact typed record with exact source snippets and locators, and emit a redaction manifest proving which page regions were excluded. Calendar/Reminders conflict queries should consume that typed record locally; relay-realtime should receive only the derived brief and cited snippets, never the untouched page. Keep the raw capture ephemeral and destroy it after the task receipt is written.

Add a browser-availability watchdog spanning the Mac bridge and relay: when a browser request arrives and /browser/status is offline or has no live tab, classify the failure, ask the Mac bridge to bring Safari/its extension to the foreground (or open a neutral Start Page), then re-check the heartbeat once. If still unavailable, return a one-sentence spoken diagnosis with the exact recovery instruction instead of queuing more commands. Keep authenticated URLs and page content out of diagnostics.

Add a private-browser self-healing handshake across Mac and Safari: when a browser read is requested and no valid Safari heartbeat exists, the local Mac agent may activate Safari and the AI Pendant Browser Bridge, issue a harmless Start Page/no-op ping, and wait for a fresh heartbeat before dispatching the original read. Bind the request to Safari's extensionId and abort if only the never-seen home-chrome stub responds. Return a typed unavailable reason instead of leaving the voice job pending.

Introduce a privacy-preserving browser observation protocol: Safari returns typed, owner-approved fields plus a signed observation receipt (device/session, tab, origin, timestamp, redirect/auth state, freshness deadline, and region hashes), while raw DOM remains on the Mac. The Mac performs joins and calculations locally and sends the relay only the minimal result and citation metadata. Expired receipts become unusable rather than silently falling back to cached text.

Define and wire a short-lived BrowserEvidencePacket shared between browser-extension, faculty-perception, and relay-realtime: packetId, tab/session lease, URL/title, extraction timestamp, ordered snippets with DOM locators and hashes, normalized fields, and optional screenshot crop references. Let follow-up voice turns request only packet citations, and invalidate packets on tab navigation or TTL expiry.

Add a page-identity attestation protocol between Safari and the pendant request path. For each read-only question, Safari signs a short-lived tuple of extension installation key, tabId, top-level origin, URL hash, DOM snapshot hash, and monotonic sequence; the Mac planner refuses to answer unless the attestation matches the tab lease and the response includes the same evidence hash. Rotate the ephemeral request key after every answer and expose only an opaque receipt to the relay.

Add an explicit ephemeral browser-to-voice handoff in the local agent: on a pendant intent or browser-button event, dispatch browser_snapshot/read_page to the active Safari tab, run deterministic redaction (password/payment/hidden inputs plus truncation), attach tab URL/title and extraction timestamp, stream the compact payload into the realtime pipeline, and delete the payload after the spoken response or a 60-second TTL. Return a typed failure when no live tab/extension exists instead of waiting for the 45-second browser timeout.

Make the granted browser command enqueue tool a real adapter instead of a schema-only stub: accept one typed browser action, POST it to /execute with request/session metadata, await the extension result (or return a durable job ID on timeout), and normalize success, no-tab, offline, auth-interstitial, CAPTCHA, and timeout states. Add a health probe that reports the last Safari heartbeat and pending-command age before dispatch.

Reconcile browser heartbeat and command-side tab enumeration into one authoritative device snapshot. On each browser action, refresh/compare tabId, windowId, URL, title, and active state; mark the device as ‘online-but-stale’ when heartbeat and list_tabs disagree, and require a fresh list_tabs before any tab-targeted mutation.

Add an authenticated-browser-to-pendant escalation path for genuinely high-salience watch changes. A page-watch report would carry a semantic urgency score and evidence capsule; the relay would queue a short spoken alert, while the pendant gives one distinctive vibration. A physical button acknowledges it, suppresses duplicate reports, and can request the cited page excerpt. Quiet hours, per-watch escalation, and a daily cap prevent notification storms; ordinary changes remain in the Mac review queue.

Add a user-visible “compare these tabs” browser action: capture normalized, provenance-linked fields from 2–6 selected authenticated tabs, run contradiction checks (date, amount, identity, status, deadline), and return a compact mismatch card with source URL, DOM locator, excerpt, and screenshot crop. Keep the active comparison attached to the pendant conversation for follow-up questions.

Introduce a signed cross-surface execution-causality record. Every action step emits a compact envelope containing goal version, step ID, selected surface, readiness snapshot, locator/target identity, evidence hash, side-effect classification, and outcome (including unknown). When a step fails, the relay freezes the cursor and fans the envelope to perception, judgment, and the appropriate Mac/browser executor; a repair proposal must reference the failed evidence and prove target equivalence before action can resume.

Add a privacy-preserving place-trigger service spanning the iOS client, relay, Mac agent, browser bridge, and pendant: iOS converts approved geofences into coarse signed place-arrival events (never uploads continuous coordinates); relay deduplicates and starts a staged, allowlisted preparation job; Mac/browser run read-and-draft-only actions; relay creates a short-lived approval token bound to the exact manifest; the pendant displays a minimal ready state and requires a deliberate button event before the final action is released. Expire or cancel the token on departure, timeout, stale private-page evidence, or changed manifest.

Add a cross-surface operation-state reconciler that derives terminal job status from append-only pipeline events and relay acknowledgements, rather than trusting the current `processing` field. It should validate event ordering, mark runs completed/failed/expired, detect orphaned uploads and stale pending browser commands, and emit one signed owner-facing receipt with the evidence IDs. A reconnecting pendant must receive only the receipt delta it has not acknowledged, keyed by pipelineId plus event sequence.

Introduce an evidence-gated Action Lease protocol across judgement, relay, Mac, browser, and pendant. A lease contains an action-plan hash, intended surface/session, preconditions, risk class, expiry, and checkpoint index. The executor must return preflight evidence before each checkpoint and postcondition evidence after it; the relay rejects stale or duplicate leases and records reconnect-safe state. For UI actions, accessibility/screen-recording reachability is a hard gate; queue acceptance is never an effect. The pendant button acknowledges only the explicitly named irreversible checkpoint, with the spoken target and hash rendered in the receipt.

Add an execution preflight barrier and resumable handoff protocol before any action job runs. The relay creates a durable job with a step-level idempotency key, required-surface contract, and approval class. Mac agent reports signed readiness (bridge/browser online, accessibility/screen-recording state, tab/session affinity, network) within a short TTL. The scheduler refuses doomed browser/computer-use steps immediately with a structured blocked receipt, parks the job, and resumes only after a heartbeat satisfies the contract. Reversible steps may retry with leases and bounded backoff; irreversible steps become approval checkpoints and are never auto-replayed. On reconnect, reconcile receipts by idempotency key before continuing, then push a concise result to the pendant and dashboard.

Add a cross-surface Action Commit Protocol between faculty-judgement, faculty-action, faculty-perception, relay, Mac, and browser: every delegated intent becomes a versioned action bundle with (1) required capabilities and live readiness snapshot, (2) explicit preconditions/evidence fingerprints, (3) an idempotency key and short execution lease, (4) a prepare phase that gathers reversible edits/drafts without committing, (5) a commit phase routed to the physically appropriate hand, and (6) mandatory postcondition verification by perception before reporting success. If readiness changes or evidence is stale, action pauses and returns a typed 'needs replan' packet rather than attempting blind GUI work. Relay persists bundles/checkpoints while the Mac is asleep or disconnected; the pendant receives only concise approval/blocked/completed prompts. This is not another receipt/undo log: it closes the judgement-to-action-to-perception loop and gives each side a shared contract.

Add a cross-surface ActionProof protocol. At planning time, faculty-judgement emits an immutable action_id and a typed postcondition (surface, locator or query, expected normalized value/hash, deadline, and privacy class). faculty-action records pre-state, dispatches to Mac or browser with idempotency_key=action_id, and returns executor_result without labeling completion. faculty-perception performs a fresh read on the declared surface, compares it to the postcondition, and emits signed proof or contradiction. Relay owns a durable state machine with bounded retries and an offline pendant notification queue; dashboard renders the evidence chain and exposes retry/undo where supported.

Add a challenge-aware execution protocol shared by browser bridge, Mac job runner, relay, and pendant: jobs become checkpointed state machines; the browser emits auth_challenge {jobId, tabId, sessionId, origin, kind, nonce, expiresAt} before any mutation, relay presents only a redacted prompt, the pendant returns signed approve/cancel for that nonce, and browser emits auth_resolved without secret contents. Resume requires same tab/session/origin, a fresh idempotency key, and a final receipt; timeout or navigation invalidates the lease and invokes cleanup.

Add an execution-admission and evidence chain in the action runner. Before each step, compile a typed preflight from live /ops/status + /observe (surface, permissions, online state, target/session, reversibility), and reject or reroute any step whose actuator is not reachable: UI clicks/typing/keys are refused when Accessibility/inputReachability is false; screenshot-dependent steps are refused when Screen Recording is absent; browser work is parked with a durable retry receipt when the extension is offline; AppleScript/shell alternatives are selected only when their declared postcondition is independently observable. Require each write step to carry the signed Evidence-to-Effect envelope (scope, expiry, idempotency key, expected postcondition, revocation reference), then append preflight, effect, independent observation, and recovery/expiry records to the existing job journal. Never report success for an unobserved UI effect.

Add a cross-surface compensation ledger rather than extending the existing last-job undo. Every action adapter must publish an effect record with stable target fingerprint, before/after capsule reference, inverse operation (or explicitly irreversible), dependency edges, and confidence. A coordinator computes a previewable compensation DAG, pauses on uncertain effects, and executes only owner-approved inverse nodes in dependency-safe order across Mac, browser, relay storage, and generated pendant artifacts.

Add a reachability-and-proof preflight barrier to every faculty-action job. Before dispatch, query Mac readiness (Accessibility/Screen Recording), browser bridge heartbeat/tab affinity, relay connectivity, and pendant link; classify each planned step as executable, queueable, or blocked. For blocked steps, fail in under 2 seconds with the exact missing surface and a one-tap recovery instruction instead of waiting 45 seconds. On reconnect, resume only idempotent queued steps under a short action lease, then attach before/after evidence and an honest receipt; never emit success from a plan or an unverified GUI attempt.

Implement a cross-surface Reachability Contract and blocked-job coordinator. Mac emits signed, expiring proofs for input posting (host bundle + executable identity + probe result), screen capture, and browser heartbeat/tab ownership. The relay stores an approved job as held when any required proof is absent, while the Mac/browser layers stop claiming success and attach a machine-readable blocker. A repair transition (owner-guided permission deep link or extension-open instruction) causes re-probe; only a fresh proof matching the original session/tab and idempotency key permits replay. Irreversible steps remain approval-gated and are never auto-replayed.

Add a proof-carrying action contract between faculty-judgement and faculty-action. Each decision is compiled into a typed ActionPlan containing target surface, ordered steps, reversibility class, preconditions, expected postconditions, freshness TTL, idempotency key, and required evidence (API response, filesystem hash, app state, or browser DOM citation). Before execution, faculty-action performs a cheap live preflight across the relevant hands: Mac reachability/Accessibility, browser heartbeat and tab affinity, relay/pendant connectivity, and permission state. It routes around unavailable hands only when the plan explicitly permits a fallback; otherwise it returns a structured blocked receipt without attempting no-op GUI actions. After each step it verifies postconditions and emits a signed receipt chain linking plan hash, observed evidence, and timestamps; stale leases or lost reachability automatically stop subsequent steps. Reversible plans remain proactive; irreversible plans execute only with a judgement-issued approval token, not an action-agent guess.

Introduce a cross-surface ActionTransaction protocol shared by faculty-judgement, faculty-action, Mac agent, browser bridge, relay, and pendant. Each transaction contains an immutable plan hash, step dependency graph, lease owner/expiry, idempotency key, precondition snapshot, and typed receipt (queued/running/blocked/completed/verified/unknown) with evidence and trust. Relay persists it; late or duplicate receipts reconcile deterministically; pendant receives progress and blocked reasons. Irreversible steps cannot transition to verified without fresh before/after proof and the required owner confirmation.

Introduce a resumable Human-in-the-loop Checkpoint protocol spanning local-agent jobs, browser sessions, relay, and pendant. A worker can emit a checkpoint containing a stable job/action hash, bounded question, typed choices or a redacted input schema, evidence capsule, continuation token, deadline, and safe rollback point. Relay persists and delivers it; pendant returns a nonce-bound response; the worker resumes only if the checkpoint hash and target session still match. Add crash recovery, duplicate-response handling, expiry, cancellation, and a dashboard timeline.

Add a cross-surface execution-readiness handshake and lease. Before any approved action, the relay asks Mac agent for a signed preflight containing Accessibility/Screen Recording readiness, browser-heartbeat freshness, target tab/session affinity, and current queue capacity. If a required surface is unavailable, persist the approved intent as a paused job with an expiry and cancellation token; the relay retries on heartbeat recovery, while the pendant announces 'waiting for browser' and a long-press cancels. Emit one terminal receipt with preflight failures, retry timestamps, and the exact action outcome—never a client-side timeout masquerading as failure.

Implement a cross-surface Action Lease + Attestation protocol. Relay creates a nonce-bound lease containing plan hash, target surface/session, allowed effect class, expiry, and approval transcript hash. Before every write, Mac/browser return signed (or HMAC-authenticated) preflight evidence: online heartbeat, entitlement state, target identity, and expected-state digest. Executor refuses on stale/mismatched evidence. After execution, faculty-perception submits independent postcondition evidence; receipts become succeeded, refused, or unknown rather than treating dispatch as success. Pendant announces the exact reason and offers retry only after readiness changes.

Build a 24 kHz duplex audio conformance harness spanning all four bodies: inject deterministic swept-tone and speech fixtures at the pendant I2S/UART test point, tag every Opus frame with a monotonic sample counter, collect relay packet/jitter telemetry, capture the Mac/ESP32 output, and compare end-to-end sample rate, drift, loss concealment, latency, and spectral error. Emit a signed receipt with per-stage timestamps and automatically quarantine/revert the last audio firmware or relay codec change when thresholds fail; keep raw audio local and upload only hashes/metrics.

Introduce a cross-surface ActionIntent/ActionReceipt protocol and executor coordinator. An intent contains an immutable canonical payload hash, target surface, permitted effect class, idempotency key, deadline, and machine-checkable postcondition. The relay owns a durable state machine (queued→leased→attempted→applied→verified or uncertain), renews leases, and emits compact progress events. Mac and browser adapters must return typed accepted/applied evidence plus a verification query; the coordinator retries only steps marked idempotent and never silently replays an unknown irreversible step. Keep a redacted receipt/evidence manifest for the owner and allow cancellation/retry of safe steps.

Add a Proof-Carrying Action protocol shared by relay, Mac/browser harnesses, and faculty-perception. Every executable action is serialized as {actionId, idempotencyKey, targetSurface, precondition, effect, postcondition predicate, verification recipe, settleMs, expiry}. Executors return dispatch evidence only. A separate verifier performs the recipe after settle and appends a signed ProofRecord {actionId, observedAt, predicate, result: confirmed|failed|unknown, source, locator/tab/session or file/pipeline reference, evidenceHash}. Relay state transitions are queued→leased→dispatched→verifying→confirmed/failed/unknown, with duplicate dispatch coalesced and stale proofs rejected. Expose GET /jobs/:id/proof and a compact pendant result packet.

Add a cross-surface action contract and verifier. Every planned Mac/browser step carries risk class, lease ID, preconditions, typed expected postconditions, observation recipe, timeout, and undo strategy. The executor must re-observe after each mutating step, compare typed fields (not screenshots alone), append before/after evidence to the receipt, and halt with an explicit mismatch state. Relay, Mac bridge, and browser bridge share the same lease and cancellation token so a stale or revoked plan cannot continue.

Add a shared approval-intent envelope and atomic commit gate between faculty-judgement, Mac planner, browser bridge, and relay. On preview, each executor emits a canonical action manifest (surface, account identity, tab/session, URL, action type, field-level normalized values, DOM/source hashes, and expiry). The pendant confirmation signs/references the manifest nonce. Immediately before execution, the same executor reacquires the live state and compares the manifest; only an exact match can enter the existing execute/browser command queue. On mismatch, cancel the queued command, emit a typed stale-approval event with changed fields and a fresh preview, and make retries idempotent. Persist the manifest and final comparison in the existing job receipt/journal so undo and audit refer to the exact approved state.

Add a cross-surface Action Checkpoint Protocol shared by relay, Mac agent, and browser bridge. Each step emits an append-only record {jobId, stepId, surface, idempotencyKey, preconditionHash, evidenceRef, outcome, committedAt}; the relay owns a durable state machine and leases, Mac/browser heartbeats renew leases, and reconnecting workers ask for the next uncommitted step. Resume logic must classify outcomes as committed, safely retryable, or unknown; unknown steps pause rather than repeat. Expose checkpoint progress and a resume/cancel control through the existing jobs, journal, browser poll/result, and pipeline event routes.

Introduce revisioned live-plan splicing across relay and local-agent workers. Add a job revision and optimistic compare-and-swap endpoint/state: the relay marks a running job paused, accepts a typed delta (skip, replace target, change account, reorder), asks perception for affected-state evidence, and commits a new plan revision only if the worker’s last-seen revision still matches. Workers must reject superseded revisions before every side effect and emit a plan-diff receipt. Deliver pendant interrupt events through the live pipeline rather than waiting for the next voice turn.

Build a durable cross-surface action saga runner. Compile a judged plan into typed steps spanning Mac, authenticated browser, and pendant; persist a per-step idempotency key, precondition fingerprint, attempt count, evidence receipt, and compensating action. Before retry/resume, faculty-perception must re-check the precondition (Accessibility/Screen Recording/input reachability, browser heartbeat/tab identity, and focused-app/UI fingerprint); a receipt is not success unless it includes typed proof. If the Mac disappears, relay keeps the saga and wakes the Mac bridge; if a step is irreversible, the pendant's one-button action lease must be explicitly armed and expires on timeout. Expose resume-from-checkpoint and safe-abort, never replay completed side effects.

Add a cross-surface Action Witness Contract and saga coordinator between existing /plan→/execute→/jobs routes and the Mac/browser bridges. Each step must declare target surface, idempotency key, precondition witness requirements, effect class (reversible/irreversible), timeout, and compensation. Before dispatch, coordinator validates a fresh witness bundle: Mac /observe inputReachability=ready plus stateWitnessId, and browser heartbeat/session epoch plus tabId. It atomically leases the step, records dispatch, and transitions outcomes to succeeded, failed, blocked, or unknown. Unknown (disconnect after dispatch) is never retried automatically; it triggers read-only reconciliation against receipt/evidence, then either resumes or asks the owner. Browser commands with stale epochs are quarantined rather than consumed. Expose saga status, step evidence, and an approval/reconcile endpoint, reusing existing job receipts and undo routes.

Add a cross-surface execution lease. When faculty-judgement creates an action with an irreversible boundary, relay issues a short-lived lease containing plan hash, destination, evidence hash, and required pendant presence. Mac/browser may prepare and pause, but cannot cross the boundary unless the pendant has recently attested the lease nonce; disappearance, expiry, browser-session change, or plan mutation revokes it. Relay deduplicates lease consumption and fans cancellation to the Mac job and browser command queue. Receipts record lease issuance, attestation, consumption, and revocation separately.

Add an end-to-end 24 kHz audio conformance runner that uses a deterministic PCM/I2S test fixture on the pendant (not the Mac microphone), sends the exact production Opus uplink through the relay, decodes the 24 kHz/60 ms downlink, and measures sample-rate tags, packet loss concealment, round-trip latency, drift, clipping, and weighted SNR against the golden vector. Have the Mac harness start/stop the run, collect /pipeline events and audio artifacts, and publish a signed pass/fail receipt with firmware, relay, codec, and wire-clock versions. Fail closed when capture is still 15,625 Hz or when any stage silently resamples to 16 kHz.

Build a cross-surface transaction coordinator between the existing /plan, /execute, browser command queue, Mac jobs, and relay. It should issue a planHash-bound transaction with explicit prepare/commit/abort states, per-step idempotency keys, leases, precondition snapshots, and one merged receipt. A pendant approval event commits only the exact still-valid hash; disconnect, stale tab, changed page, or lease expiry aborts safely. Keep browser and Mac evidence local/redacted and persist only hashes, statuses, and receipt pointers.

Add a cross-node capability-token firewall for actions. Before faculty-action hands work to the Mac or authenticated browser, the relay mints a short-lived, single-use token scoped to an exact operation, target (app/tab/account), fields or files allowed, maximum side effects, and expiry. Mac and browser adapters must present that token for every mutation; they return a signed receipt containing the token hash, target identity, and before/after evidence. A token cannot be replayed on another tab, job, or surface, and relay logs contain only the scope and hashes—not credentials or page contents.

Add a postcondition-verification stage to every irreversible Mac/browser job. The planner must emit a typed expected invariant (for example, appointment status=confirmed, draft remains unsent, reminder exists with exact time). After execution, a separate perception pass re-reads the authoritative surface—browser tab/session for web state, AppleScript/read-only route for Mac state—and stores a signed verification record alongside the existing receipt. If the invariant is false, ambiguous, or the tab/session changed, mark the job “unverified” rather than successful, stop retries, push a pendant alert with the observed value, and offer an explicit recovery/undo job. Use the same operation key for retries and require compare-before-commit when possible.

Introduce a durable cross-surface saga coordinator rather than treating each Mac/browser action as an independent job. Persist a DAG of typed nodes with dependency barriers, commit markers, idempotency keys, expected postconditions, and explicit compensation policies. On reconnect, resume only the first uncommitted node; after each node, run a read-only verifier before releasing dependents. Expose partial-success and paused-for-owner states through the existing job and receipt APIs, and make unsafe compensation impossible to auto-run.

Build an end-to-end audio acceptance transaction that creates a local tagged test stream, correlates relay pipeline events with pendant decode/I2S counters and ESP32/A2DP telemetry, computes per-hop latency/jitter/loss/underruns, stores a signed receipt, and automatically tears down the test. It must fail closed when telemetry is missing rather than infer success from HTTP 200.

Add a provenance-preserving browser-to-reminder handoff transaction: browser extraction must return a cited source (tab/session, URL, timestamp, quote, normalized date and timezone, confidence); the Mac reminder creator must accept that typed payload and return the reminder ID; the relay stores one receipt linking source evidence to the created reminder; the pendant speaks only the minimal result. Reject the handoff when the date is ambiguous or the source tab changed between extraction and creation.

Implement a durable cross-surface execution checkpoint protocol. Before each Mac or browser step, write a checkpoint containing jobId, stepId, idempotency key, consequence class, precondition hash, and expected witness. After execution, append separate attempted and witnessed receipts; on disconnect, crash, timeout, or browser-session loss, mark the step interrupted rather than retrying. Add a resume endpoint that selects only the next unverified step after fresh precondition/readback checks, and publish compact pending/interrupted/disputed/resumable events to the pendant stream. Keep the full evidence local to the Mac/bridge and send the relay only a redacted status plus checkpoint id.

Add a divergence-aware execution interlock between planning and action. Compile every step into a semantic precondition snapshot (recipient, amount, URL/origin, selected account, target file, permission state, and stable field identifiers). Before committing a step, compare the live Mac/browser state to that snapshot. If it differs, atomically pause the job, invalidate its action lease, store a minimal redacted diff plus the last safe checkpoint, and emit a pendant decision event with approve-corrected-plan, edit, cancel, or owner-takeover options. On approval, generate a new plan revision linked to the old one; never mutate the old plan or replay prior steps.

Add a durable cross-surface action-card coordinator between relay, Mac agent, and browser bridge. It accepts one request_id and fan-outs to native AppleScript adapters (Mail, Calendar, Finder/Notes, Messages, Safari/Chrome) plus authenticated browser tabs, normalizes each result into {source, subject, snippet, timestamp, URL/deep-link, confidence, suggested reversible action}, deduplicates by stable hash, writes a local ~/AI-Pendant-Workspace/workbench/<request_id> artifact, and emits progress/completion receipts consumable by the pendant. Each adapter checkpoints independently so a dropped browser bridge or Mac sleep resumes without repeating work.

Insert a Mac-local privacy broker as the mandatory boundary between native/browser execution and relay/model calls. Adapters return structured fields rather than prose; the broker applies a per-task allowlist, secret/PII classification, purpose and TTL, performs joins locally, computes source hashes and a redacted preview, and emits only the approved projection plus an audit receipt. The relay rejects untyped/raw payloads, while action execution consumes the same approved projection so the preview and the eventual operation are cryptographically linked.

Add an Action Escrow state machine between /plan, /execute, the browser command queue, and job receipts rather than treating them as independent calls. Persist one escrow record with intent hash, idempotency key, bound surface/session/tab/account, preconditions, postcondition, owner-confirmation nonce, lease expiry, and evidence pointers. Transition atomically through proposed → target-verified → awaiting-pendant-confirmation → executing → independently-verified → committed, with expired/drifted/failed terminal states. Make /execute refuse an unconfirmed or drifted escrow; make browser/Mac results append evidence to the same record; make faculty-perception close only after a fresh read; expose the complete state through existing /jobs/:jobId and receipts and make undo reference the committed escrow, not merely the last action.

Introduce a Witness Quorum layer between execution and completion reporting. Every side effect gets an action hash and evidence envelope. The executor's receipt is only one witness; a separate observer must independently re-read the target or an independent confirmation channel. Correlate witnesses by action hash, target binding, and freshness; classify the outcome as witnessed, disputed, or unknown. Expose that classification through job status/receipts and prevent the relay from saying “done” when only the executor acknowledged. For safe operations, allow an explicitly classified retry; for non-idempotent operations, freeze and request owner review.

Build an end-to-end 24 kHz audio conformance and recovery harness: firmware emits deterministic mic/speaker loopback vectors and sequence counters; relay validates Opus packet cadence, resampling, CRC/order, and jitter-buffer behavior; Mac harness runs long-duration fixtures and records MOS-adjacent underrun/latency metrics; failures become timestamped receipts and a UART-readable diagnostic bundle. Add negotiated fallback profiles (24 kHz primary, 16 kHz compatibility) rather than silently transcoding.

Implement a shared ActionContract v1 and reducer between judgement and existing executors. Each run contains contractVersion, runId, owner-visible goal, ordered/parallel steps, target surface, idempotencyKey, preconditions (resource fingerprint + observedAt + expiry), effect class, approval requirement, timeout, and compensation. The relay persists a state machine (planned→ready→running→blocked/awaiting_approval→succeeded/failed/compensated), grants a short lease per step, and accepts exactly-once step receipts from Mac/browser. On reconnect it reconciles receipts by idempotencyKey before dispatching anything; a changed fingerprint becomes blocked, never retried blindly. Reduce all receipts, browser results, journal entries, and pipeline events into one final run report and pendant event.

Add a cross-surface transaction coordinator between faculty-judgement and the existing browser/Mac executors. It persists a versioned action plan with before/after evidence, idempotency key, approval nonce/expiry, and correlation ID; exposes prepare→approve→execute→verify→reconcile states; refuses writes when evidence hash or tab/session changes; serializes browser and Mac side effects; after disconnect polls receipts and the external page before classifying acknowledged/uncertain/failed. Emit compact state transitions to the relay/pipeline so the pendant can say exactly what is waiting without claiming success.

Add a resumable audio-delivery protocol for 24 kHz generated briefings: the Mac/relay emits an operation-scoped manifest (codec, sample rate, duration, chunk hashes), the relay sends numbered chunks with bounded backpressure, and the pendant ACKs the highest contiguous chunk plus a final playback receipt. Persist only the manifest and a short replay window; on reconnect resume from the last ACK instead of restarting or duplicating speech. Surface underruns, codec mismatch, and truncated playback as explicit job/briefing status.

Add a cross-surface action transaction protocol. Before faculty-action executes a judged plan, each step must carry a typed target, precondition snapshot (device/session/tab, identity, relevant field values), intended effect, reversibility class, and verification query. The relay assigns an idempotency key and short action lease; the Mac/browser executor rechecks the precondition immediately before the mutation, refuses on drift or stale lease, then runs the verification query and emits a signed receipt containing before/after evidence. On link loss the relay keeps the transaction pending (never retries a mutation blindly), and the pendant can announce pending/succeeded/blocked when it reconnects. Extend existing receipts and undo records rather than creating a second history.

Add a cross-surface commit coordinator between judgement and faculty-action. It materializes a versioned action graph (Mac, browser, relay, pendant), assigns each step an idempotency key and pre/postcondition, and stores append-only checkpoints. Browser and Mac workers must return typed evidence (dispatch, observed-before, observed-after, or unknown). The coordinator retries only steps declared idempotent, pauses on unknown/non-idempotent outcomes, and emits one signed receipt stream consumed by relay-realtime, the pendant, and dashboard. On reconnect, the pendant receives the pending commit state and a concise spoken result rather than a duplicate command.

Add a bounded Contingency Case runtime, distinct from one-shot jobs and page watches. A case stores a goal, evidence assertions, expiry, stop conditions, and a finite set of owner-approved reversible branches. Each observation creates a versioned state transition; the runtime may execute only the branch whose preconditions match, records before/after evidence, and emits an exception event when no branch matches. Relay wakes the case on schedule or browser/Mac events, while the pendant receives a compact “decision needed” prompt with the relevant evidence and a one-button defer/stop response.

Add a cross-surface 24 kHz audio conformance sentinel: a pendant firmware test mode emits a short locally generated calibration chirp and captures a timestamped reference window; the relay tags each Opus packet with sequence, source sample-rate, encode/decode timestamps, and loss markers; the Mac harness runs the test on demand and stores a compact receipt (measured capture rate, decoded rate, jitter, packet loss, underruns, CPU headroom) in the job receipt. The relay rejects silently mislabelled 16 kHz packets and selects a safe fallback profile rather than claiming superwideband success. Expose the latest pass/fail and failure stage through the existing pipeline/job status surfaces.

Introduce a signed, append-only operation envelope shared by relay, Mac agent, and browser bridge. Each envelope carries operationId, parent decisionId, target invariant, preconditions, approval state, idempotency key, per-step lease, typed result, evidence reference, and terminal outcome (proven/failed/unknown). Require every surface to echo the operationId; have the relay reconcile late/out-of-order events and expose one causal timeline to the pendant. This is a protocol change, not another action endpoint, and it must cover browser commands and Mac jobs uniformly.

Add a cross-surface shadow-execution engine that runs an approved action plan against captured, redacted state snapshots before touching the live Mac or browser. It should compute an expected diff and dependency impact (files, calendar entries, messages, account fields), detect conflicting concurrent changes, and attach the snapshot hash to the eventual live execution. The live executor must abort if the current state no longer matches the simulated basis, then request a fresh plan.

Add an end-to-end audio format contract enforced at every pipeline boundary. The contract must carry declared sample rate, actual PCM frame count, channels, codec, clock domain, and resampler stage; validate that capture (currently observed as 15,625 Hz), Opus uplink (16 kHz), relay transcode, TTS output (24 kHz), and pendant playback (24 kHz decoded / 31,250 Hz I2S wire clock) are not silently conflated. Reject or mark a run as format_mismatch when metadata and byte-derived duration disagree, and emit one machine-readable resampling manifest with the pipeline receipt.

Implement a contract-bound action transaction that sits between /plan, /execute, the job queue, Mac/browser runners, and pipeline events. At plan time, canonicalize target, preconditions, permitted side effects, expiry, and confirmation requirement into contractHash. At execution, atomically acquire a short lease and emit lease/running/paused events; every Mac or browser step must include contractHash, requestId, tab/session affinity, and a before-state digest. Reject stale or mismatched steps. On completion, run postcondition checks against fresh reads, append a signed receipt containing evidence references and the exact contractHash, and only then emit completed for spoken playback. If the pendant playback predicate is absent, emit delivered-to-relay rather than falsely claiming the owner heard it. Reuse jobs/undo-last only for steps explicitly marked reversible.

Add a compensating-recovery planner for partially completed cross-surface actions. When a job stops after step n, derive a bounded recovery graph from each completed step's declared compensation (for example, restore a draft field or move a file back), distinguish safe compensation from irreversible external effects, and present the owner a spoken/inspectable choice: leave as-is, compensate selected reversible steps, or resume from the exact checkpoint after a fresh precondition check. Store the partial-state snapshot and compensation result in the same receipt, rather than treating jobs/undo-last as a single global undo.

Implement a relay-owned Action Transaction Coordinator between the existing /execute, Mac jobs, and browser command queue. It should compile a goal into typed steps (surface, effect class, idempotency key, preconditions, approval requirement, lease expiry), dispatch one step at a time, correlate browser result or Mac receipt by the same step ID, and advance only after proof matches the precondition/postcondition. Persist a compact event log and expose GET /action-transactions/:id, POST /action-transactions/:id/approve, POST /action-transactions/:id/cancel, POST /action-transactions/:id/resume. On timeout or disconnect, freeze the lease and resume from the last proven checkpoint instead of replaying writes.

Add an action-graph executor between judgement and the surface tools. Compile a decision into typed steps with required surface, fallback surfaces, preconditions, reversibility, and confirmation class. Execute ready steps independently; when a surface is offline, mark only dependent steps blocked, attempt explicitly allowlisted fallbacks (for example granted AppleScript instead of browser UI), persist step receipts and evidence, and resume when reachability changes. The final response must distinguish completed, skipped, blocked, and awaiting-confirmation steps.

Introduce a cross-surface Handoff Lease protocol. A pendant-originated handoff stores an immutable capture pointer plus a normalized goal and expiry; the relay waits for cryptographically attested Mac-bridge and browser-session presence, grants one short lease to the executor, and collects Mac receipts plus browser evidence into a single review packet. Leases expire and return to pending without duplicate execution.

Add a cross-surface causal ledger, separate from the existing per-job receipts: every action attempt must reference a predecessor evidence hash and publish a postcondition evidence hash containing the target surface, identity, timestamp, and observed state. The relay should accept a successor only when the predecessor is committed, reject duplicate effect IDs across Mac/browser/pendant, and mark the whole chain compensatable, abandoned, or needs-owner-review when a link disappears. Reconnection should reconcile by querying evidence, never by replaying the last command.

Add a two-phase cross-surface action coordinator. Phase 1 (prepare) asks browser-extension and Mac executor to resolve each typed action against its current tab/app, capture a redacted before-state hash and proposed after-state, and reserve an idempotency key without mutating. Phase 2 (commit) executes steps in dependency order only if all required reservations are fresh; after every mutation it records proof and evaluates the postcondition. On partial failure it stops, marks the packet mixed, and invokes only declared compensations (or presents a precise manual recovery list).

Implement a cross-surface Execution Envelope and fence coordinator. Every delegated job gets a compact signed envelope: job/thread id, monotonic checkpoint, target surface, preconditions/state hashes, idempotency key, reversible/undo handle, expiry, approval boundary, and receipt schema. Relay persists it and owns lease expiry; Mac/browser workers must validate the lease before each step and emit typed receipts. A pendant button/event or disconnect policy writes a signed pause fence; workers stop at the next safe boundary. Resume first runs reconciliation against current Mac/browser state and receipts, then advances only uncompleted idempotency keys. Dashboard and spoken status render the same envelope rather than inventing per-surface status.

Add a durable cross-surface Intent Handoff protocol between pendant/relay and Mac/browser jobs. On voice capture, create an intent envelope {idempotencyKey, normalized goal, allowed read scopes, confirmation policy, createdAt, expiry}; persist only encrypted metadata in relay. When /browser/status reports the bridge online, claim the envelope exactly once, create or resume a /jobs task bound to the browser session, and stream state transitions queued→claimed→extracting→waiting-for-confirmation→completed/failed. Attach source URL/tab/timestamp/snippet hashes to the receipt, synthesize a short audio result, and let the pendant cancel or replay by intent ID. Do not auto-resubmit after ambiguous failures.

Add a cross-surface temporal snapshot protocol. At the instant a spoken goal is accepted, the relay issues a snapshot nonce; the Mac agent records a manifest of relevant local files/apps, the browser bridge records tab URLs and bounded extraction hashes, and the perception layer records the pendant request plus timestamps. Judgement and action may reference only that nonce. The Mac review surface renders a replayable evidence bundle showing what was observed, what changed during preparation, and which facts are now stale; any mutation must revalidate the affected item immediately before execution.

Implement a resumable cross-surface approval envelope and job state machine between the existing planner/executor, browser queue, pipeline, and receipts. When an action reaches a declared gate, persist {jobId, actionId, target surface/tab, redacted preview, precondition hash, effect class, expiry, nonce}; emit a pipeline event and pendant prompt. Accept exactly one authenticated confirmation carrying the nonce, re-check the precondition, then resume the same actionId (never re-plan or replay completed IDs). On mismatch/expiry/disconnect, transition to held and require a fresh preview. Append the prompt, confirmation, re-check, and final receipt to the existing job and pipeline records.

Add a deterministic contingency-policy engine that runs after every failed, timed-out, or partially completed Mac/browser step. Policies are compiled into an allowlisted decision table before execution (for example: browser timeout → capture current URL/title and save local draft; permission failure → notify and hold; changed precondition → discard draft and request review; network loss → retry once then cancel). The engine must atomically checkpoint safe artifacts, emit a typed pipeline event, and attach the selected rule plus evidence to the existing receipt. It must never infer permission for a new side effect from a natural-language failure summary.

Install a mandatory action-preflight gate between faculty-judgement plans and every mutating executor. For each step, require a fresh signed observation (<=15 s) proving the target surface is reachable: Mac inputReachability/uiActionsWillReachTheScreen for UI actions, browser extension online plus matching session/tab for browser actions, and a live lease for any pendant-triggered action. If the proof is absent, stale, or mismatched, do not dispatch; persist a blocked receipt with the exact missing precondition and wake/re-evaluate on the next device heartbeat. Include the observation hash and expiry in the final receipt so a later agent can tell whether the action really reached the world.

Add a cross-surface completion ledger and verifier: every judgement action carries an idempotency key, expected postcondition (typed entity/field/operator/value), evidence scope, deadline, and approval class. The relay persists state planned→dispatched→observed→verified|unverified|failed; the Mac executor/browser bridge reports dispatch receipts only, while faculty-perception (or a cheaper verifier worker) must attach fresh, redacted evidence from the target surface before the ledger emits completion. On timeout, retry only idempotent reads or surface a pending/unverified state; never replay a write merely because verification is late. Emit state transitions to /pipeline/events and expose a compact owner-facing receipt linked to existing job receipts and undo.

Build an evidence ledger and receipt reducer spanning Mac jobs, browser commands, relay pipeline events, and pendant telemetry. Every event gets a monotonic event ID, source/device identity, source timestamp plus ingestion timestamp, job/action/artifact linkage, and one of queued/accepted/executing/executed/delivered/played/failed/unknown. Reducer rules must never promote state from historical acceptance or timeout; stale or contradictory sources produce unknown with reasons. Expose a per-action timeline and freshness badge through the existing job receipts/ops snapshot, and let faculty-action request a retry only after faculty-judgement sees the explicit unknown state.

Add a causal-state layer around each plan: capture a minimal, provenance-tagged read-only baseline immediately before execution; propagate one correlation ID through Mac action receipts, browser command/results, relay pipeline events, and device acknowledgements; capture the same typed fields afterward; and compute an expected-versus-observed delta. Mark fields as expected, incidental, unexplained, or unverifiable. For external services, use field hashes and stable identifiers rather than retaining page contents. Expose the preflight prediction and postflight delta as a signed artifact attached to the job, not as an inferred sentence in the model prompt.

Add a durable, idempotent action-bundle protocol spanning relay and Mac agent. Each bundle contains a requestId, normalized target, exact parameters hash, preconditions, postconditions, expiry, confirmation token (if needed), and preferred executor. Dispatch must first re-check readiness and preconditions; execution emits receipts; faculty-perception independently probes the postcondition through typed APIs/AppleScript/browser inspection. Only a verified postcondition transitions the bundle to completed. Offline browser, missing permissions, absent pendant, timeout, or ambiguous UI transitions to queued/blocked/unknown with a retry policy and never to done. Surface the same state and evidence capsule in relay speech and dashboard, and make retries/undo use the same idempotency key.

Implement an intent-drift firewall at the final-commit boundary. Faculty-judgement emits a canonical, expiring intent capsule with typed fields (actor, recipient, destination, amount, object, scope, attachments, side effects, and allowed alternatives). Every Mac, AppleScript, and browser executor must submit its final mutation capsule to the firewall before committing. The firewall performs deterministic field comparisons plus a policy-driven semantic comparison, invalidates stale approvals when tab/session/page identity or material fields change, and returns allow, block, or ask-owner-with-diff. Resume tokens must be single-use and parameter-bound; retries cannot bypass the firewall.

Introduce a capability-token authority layer shared by faculty-judgement, relay, Mac, and browser executors. Judgement issues a signed, narrow token containing policy ID/version, permitted operation grammar, resource/account scope, quantitative limits, sensitive-field exclusions, expiry, max uses, and required confirmation levels. Before every concrete Mac or browser step, the executor verifies the token against the normalized step and consumes a nonce; a mismatch hard-stops without dispatch. The relay exposes revoke-all and token-status, while the Mac/browser surfaces return the exact failed predicate. Persist only token hashes and audit metadata, and support an offline revocation cache on the Mac so a stale grant cannot survive relay loss.

Create an Execution Truth Contract shared by faculty-judgement and faculty-action. Before dispatch, action faculty snapshots /ops/status and /browser/status and classifies each candidate path as viable, blocked, or queued. The dispatcher must attach an idempotency key and expected postcondition to every step, route private browser work only to an online authenticated bridge, prefer granted AppleScript for Mac operations when Accessibility/Screen Recording are false, and persist the classification. After dispatch, a separate read-only verifier checks the postcondition (receipt plus independent state read); only that result may produce “done”. If the bridge is offline or the Mac reports ready:false, emit a truthful blocked/queued state and retain the job rather than claiming success or burning retries.

Add a cross-surface saga coordinator above the existing action executors. A saga is a signed plan of named effects and read-only verification steps, with dependency edges and idempotency keys. Persist a checkpoint only after independent evidence confirms each effect. On timeout or contradictory evidence, freeze downstream effects, classify the workflow as partial_success/unknown/blocked, and generate a recovery plan; execute a compensating effect only when its reversibility and target identity are proven. Merge Mac action receipts, Calendar/Mail state, and browser evidence into one reconciliation object that faculty-action can speak and the owner can inspect.

Introduce a postcondition-carrying execution envelope and an independent verification barrier. Extend each planned action with a typed predicate (authority, selector/API, expected state, freshness, and acceptable uncertainty). After faculty-action finishes, faculty-perception—not the acting executor—must obtain fresh evidence from the authoritative Mac API or authenticated browser tab and classify the outcome confirmed, contradicted, or unknown. The relay should continue only verification-safe retries, never replay an irreversible action, and emit a pendant notification with the evidence reference and terminal state. Persist a tamper-evident before/action/after evidence chain alongside the existing receipt.

Build a cross-surface outcome reconciler for actions whose truth is only visible after the mutation: model each approved goal as a transaction with an intended outcome, a set of independent confirmation queries, and a deadline. After Mac or browser execution, query the other relevant surface (for example, verify a locally-created calendar item appears in the authenticated calendar, or verify a submitted browser form produces the expected confirmation message), compare the observed state to the intended outcome, and classify the job as confirmed, partially completed, contradicted, or unverifiable. On contradiction, stop further dependent work and present the owner with the exact divergent fields and a suggested recovery plan; never claim success from an HTTP/UI click alone.

Create a durable cross-surface Action Transaction coordinator between browser bridge, Mac executor, relay jobs, and pendant events. It should issue a lease-bound transaction ID; collect typed observations (session/tab identity, URL, content hash/freshness, Mac app/path state); run only reversible prepare steps; pause at a commit gate; require a pendant button/voice approval bound to the exact preview hash; re-observe all preconditions immediately before commit; reject stale or untrusted GUI/browser results; then publish one receipt with per-step evidence, undoability, and final status. Reconcile queued browser commands by idempotency key after heartbeat and mark abandoned leases expired rather than replaying them.

Introduce an ActionOutcome v1 envelope shared by executor, browser bridge, relay, and faculty-perception. Every step must transition queued→running→(completed_verified | completed_unverified | blocked_unreachable | failed_no_effect | partial | rolled_back), carrying actionId, lease expiry, preflight reachability, before-state digest, postcondition predicate, proof source/timestamp, and retry/repair hint. Make the relay refuse a spoken 'done' when the terminal state is not completed_verified; publish state transitions via /pipeline/events, persist the evidence pointer alongside /jobs/:jobId/receipts, and have the Mac/browser adapters emit blocked_unreachable when their preflight says input or session access is unavailable instead of returning success.

Implement a cross-surface action transaction coordinator. On planning, assign a taskId and deterministic step IDs; each browser or Mac executor claims a short lease, records precondition observations, performs at most one side effect, then must attach a postcondition proof (URL/title/selected-text hash for browser; path/app/value/hash for Mac). The relay persists the state machine and evidence, reclaims expired leases without replaying completed steps, pauses at irreversible checkpoints for owner confirmation, and emits one typed receipt to dashboard and pendant. If a surface reports success but its reachability probe or postcondition fails, classify it as unverified and never advance the dependent step.

Add a causal action ledger that links each irreversible action to the exact observation, transformation, approval digest, executor, and postcondition proof that caused it. Store immutable content hashes and typed references rather than copied sensitive content; expose a human-readable timeline and machine-checkable export. Reject execution when an action has no current observation or when its cited evidence changed after planning, instead of allowing a receipt to exist without provenance.

Add a cross-surface action transaction coordinator above /plan and /execute. For every judged action bundle, create a durable transaction with an idempotency key, explicit preconditions, a short owner approval lease, and a per-step evidence requirement. Route reversible Mac steps through mac_run_actions and authenticated browser steps through the browser command queue; after each step, collect typed state evidence (job receipt, browser result, AppleScript/readback, or pipeline event), mark the step committed only when the expected state is observed, and stop/recover on mismatch. Expose one compact spoken status plus a durable journal linking transaction, step, evidence, undo token, and final outcome. This is not another receipt: it makes a multi-device action atomic-ish and prevents claiming completion after partial execution.

Add a relay-owned Handoff Transaction Coordinator between judgement and action surfaces. It canonicalizes the planned action and evidence into an actionHash, stores handoffId plus target/session bindings and expiry, exposes side-effect-free preflight, accepts exactly one approval token, then dispatches idempotently to Mac and browser. Immediately before each irreversible step it rechecks evidence freshness, target identity, bridge health, and prior step receipts; any mismatch transitions to BLOCKED before the step and emits a concise pendant event. Persist append-only decision/step receipts and link existing undo/cancel operations to the same handoff.

Add a cross-surface execution-recovery layer based on reconciliation, not blind retry. Every multi-step action records a durable checkpoint containing the intended mutation, target identity, and an idempotency key. After a crash, timeout, bridge reconnect, or Mac restart, a background reconciler queries the authoritative surface (browser page state, Mail/Calendar/Files via AppleScript, and job receipts), classifies each step as NOT_STARTED, COMPLETED, UNKNOWN, or DIVERGED, and resumes only from proven NOT_STARTED steps. UNKNOWN or DIVERGED steps become a review item with evidence; they are never replayed automatically.

Add a resumable-work coordinator between the relay job store, action receipts, Mac executor, and browser session store. On resume, it loads the last job graph, verifies each step's idempotency key and preconditions, marks completed steps immutable, retries only safe untouched/failed steps with exponential backoff, and pauses at an irreversible or approval-gated step. Emit pipeline events for resumed, skipped, blocked, and completed states and expose a compact pendant-safe status/receipt.

Add a postcondition contract and independent verification stage to the existing plan/execute/job pipeline. faculty-judgement emits typed predicates (for example file_hash, reminder_present, app_value, browser_dom_text) with target surface and freshness deadline. faculty-action records intent and executor receipt, then dispatches a read-back through the appropriate Mac AppleScript/file API or authenticated browser tab. faculty-perception evaluates evidence against the predicate, writes a minimal evidence record, and emits queued/running/executed/verified/failed/expired events. Keep executor receipts and verification evidence separate so a successful dispatch can never be presented as proof of effect; expose both through /jobs/:jobId/receipts and relay_job_status.

Add strict typed-action validation and canonicalization at the /execute/mac action boundary before a job is persisted or sent to the Mac. Validate required fields by action type (open_app.appName, run_shell.command, run_applescript.script, etc.), reject malformed plans with a structured validation_error and repair hint, and preserve the original natural-language command separately. Add contract tests that exercise planner output through /execute and ensure no misleading 'failed execution' receipt is created for a request that never reached an executor.

Create a durable conditional-action contract layer between page watches/events and executors. A contract stores a normalized trigger predicate, allowed action graph, hard limits (amount, destination, time window, account/session), expiry, and an owner-selected consequence policy. On each watch/event update, the relay evaluates the predicate deterministically, asks a background model only to extract candidate fields from cited page evidence, and emits either a no-op, a prepared action, or a pendant escalation. Immediately before any mutation it re-reads the authenticated source, recomputes the predicate, and requires the executor receipt to reference the same contract revision and evidence hashes. This is not a passive watch or a generic job runner: it is the missing connective control plane that converts an external event into a constrained, auditable action.

Add a cross-surface execution contract between faculty-judgement and faculty-action. Every dispatched plan carries typed steps {target surface, preconditions, intended effect, proof obligation, confirmation class, idempotency key, expiry}. faculty-action may execute reversible steps autonomously, but must return a structured receipt only after satisfying the proof obligation (for example: reminder ID exists, file hash matches, browser field value is observed after reload); otherwise it reports blocked/unknown rather than success. The relay persists the contract and checkpoints, routes each step to Mac AppleScript, browser bridge, or relay, and resumes only uncompleted idempotency keys after disconnect/restart. Irreversible steps stop at the existing confirmation boundary. This is intentionally narrower than a generic durable runner: it prevents the mind from saying 'done' when an action merely dispatched.

Add a cross-surface commit protocol shared by relay, Mac agent, browser bridge, and pendant: every externally visible action receives a canonical intentId, draftHash, target fingerprint, expiry, and risk class; the relay exposes a pending-commit record, the pendant displays a distinct LED/button confirmation state, the Mac/browser executor refuses stale or mismatched commits, and completion requires a typed postcondition proof (or an explicit unverifiable result) before a receipt is spoken. Keep preparation and commit separate so reconnects cannot replay a send.

Add a pendant-minted, one-shot delegation token for high-consequence actions. The pendant signs a compact scope (operation class, exact target or draft hash, expiry, and maximum amount/recipient), the relay validates it and attaches it to the job, and the Mac/browser executor must present the same token at commit. Consume it atomically and publish a tamper-evident receipt; reconnects may resume preparation but can never mint or replay the commit token.

Add a single Action Ledger and reconciler between judgement, action, and perception. On /plan, persist a typed DAG of steps with idempotency keys, preconditions, postconditions, approval class, and target surface. Every executor (Mac action, browser command, relay job, or pendant delivery) must append append-only started/blocked/completed evidence. A separate verifier reads the resulting Mac/browser/relay state and emits verified, disproven, or unverifiable. The reducer exposes one terminal outcome and automatically marks jobs with no heartbeat past their lease as interrupted rather than processing forever; undo links to the exact receipt evidence.

Add a field-reconciliation layer that sits above Mac and browser action primitives. It should normalize a requested fact into typed fields, collect current values with source and timestamp, detect conflicts and semantic duplicates, require an explicit canonical value for disagreements, and emit a signed field-level mutation set. Each mutation must be staged before execution and bound to the exact source/value snapshot; if any source changes, invalidate only affected fields rather than replaying the whole set.

Add a cross-surface physical commit lease: faculty-judgement creates a canonical action digest and nonce; relay stores it with a 10-second deadline; the Mac/browser executor refuses any commit without a matching pendant button event, then writes one receipt keyed by the nonce. Expose armed/expired/committed states to the pendant LED/audio adapter.

Build a USB-session guardian that watches the nRF9160 and ESP32 serial identities, performs a synthetic audio handshake on connect, records monotonic counters and firmware/bridge versions, and publishes one compact health state to relay and the pendant. On disconnect, stop issuing audio jobs and mark queued playback as pending rather than failed.

Introduce a resumable cross-surface workflow contract: every delegated browser/Mac step emits a redacted checkpoint containing workflow ID, tab/session identity, precondition hash, side-effect status, next step, and one optional owner decision schema. The relay holds the checkpoint while the Mac sleeps or the pendant is offline; on return, the executor revalidates the page hash before continuing and otherwise asks for fresh perception.

Add an action saga coordinator that joins relay jobs, Mac action receipts, browser request IDs, and pendant serial event sequence numbers into one transaction graph. Each step publishes prepared/committed/failed/compensated state; the coordinator can pause at a missing proof, retry only idempotent steps, and expose one owner-readable timeline rather than claiming success from a 200 response.

Add a local pendant serial supervisor on the Mac that owns /dev/cu.usbmodem00096003658* discovery, frames button/LED/audio-control events, authenticates the device per connection, and exposes a narrow local event stream to faculty-action. Implement a deterministic `privacy_latch` action: on the configured gesture, lock the Mac and mute output immediately, enqueue browser tab parking, and write an encrypted receipt with before/after state. Do not flash firmware; initially support a host-injected test event and the existing dev-board button protocol.

Build a pendant-bound completion channel for action jobs: every Mac/browser job emits a small signed outcome envelope (succeeded, needs-review, failed, cancelled, with human-readable next step) to the relay, which queues it for the connected Mac/ESP32 audio bridge and pulses the pendant LED. Delivery must be idempotent and resumable, so a job finished while the owner was away is announced on the next physical reconnect rather than silently disappearing.

Add a Context Capture Broker between the pendant event stream, Mac machine-context, browser session inspection, and /capture. On one debounced intentional button event, it snapshots active app/tab metadata, applies URL/secret redaction locally, writes a provenance-linked capture record, and emits one spoken acknowledgment; do not make the classifier itself responsible for device or browser polling.

Introduce a Resumable Task Bundle manifest that atomically records task goal, exact file paths, browser session/tab IDs, completed step receipts, pending reversible steps, and a single blocked decision. Add a restore coordinator that reopens only those resources and returns a typed partial-restore report; this is a new cross-surface object, not another job queue.

Add a local USB device supervisor that opens the nRF9160 and ESP32 serial ports by stable USB identity, performs a signed hello/capability negotiation, bridges framed 24 kHz audio and button/LED events into the existing /pipeline session, and exposes transport state (attached, authenticated, audio-ready, last frame, fault) to the relay. It must fail closed on unknown serial devices and never auto-flash firmware.

Add an action-proof bridge that correlates every cross-surface operation into one human-readable timeline: spoken intent, evidence gathered from each private tab, exact proposed mutations, pendant confirmation event (or explicit refusal), execution result, and undo/receipt links. Render the timeline as a local review card and make the relay able to answer “what did you actually do?” without rerunning the Mac or browser.

Add a pendant–Mac transition broker that consumes USB serial connect/disconnect and button events, assigns a monotonic device-event ID, snapshots the Mac/browser state once per event, and publishes a durable correlation record linking event, capture card, briefing, and later job receipt. Deduplicate reconnect storms and expose an explicit expiry/forget operation.

Add a cross-surface failure envelope and recovery coordinator. Every Mac/browser step emits a typed checkpoint with action class (replayable, inspect-only, irreversible), redacted evidence pointers, and an idempotency key. The relay joins those events with job receipts and pendant connectivity, freezes only the unsafe suffix after a disconnect or error, and exposes one repair/continue decision rather than allowing a whole workflow to replay.

Build a USB-tethered pendant action bus on the Mac that treats the nRF9160 serial link as a real input/output surface today: timestamp and authenticate button press/release/long-press frames, attach them to the current Mac/browser session, enqueue an action or cancellation, and drive the pendant LED through a small state machine (queued, inspecting, ready-for-confirmation, succeeded, failed, expired). Persist an append-only event and receipt record so a dropped serial link cannot duplicate an action when it reconnects.

Add a USB-attached pendant/bridge proxy on the Mac agent. Enumerate /dev/cu.usbmodem00096003658* and /dev/cu.usbserial-0287A9CA, frame button/LED/audio-control messages with sequence numbers and heartbeats, and expose the pendant as a local device session to the relay. Translate relay job progress and cancel into LED patterns and button events, while explicitly marking this as USB-local (not LTE-registered). Keep serial access exclusive, reconnect safely, and never flash firmware.

Add a local USB-serial pendant gateway in the Mac agent: open /dev/cu.usbmodem00096003658* and /dev/cu.usbserial-0287A9CA with exclusive, read-only-safe framing; normalize button, audio-ready, disconnect, and bridge playback events into authenticated pipeline events; route haptic/LED receipts back only after the relay records the job receipt. Include reconnect backoff, sequence numbers, and a simulator mode so no flash or firmware change is needed.

Add a cross-surface action lease with a visible two-phase state machine: faculty-judgement issues an intent with expiry and required proof; faculty-action executes only reversible preparation steps, records per-step receipts, and sends a compact success/failure cue to the pendant. If the browser heartbeat, Mac bridge, or audio bridge disappears, the lease pauses and resumes from the last proven step rather than replaying earlier steps.

Add a local USB pendant companion transport in the Mac bridge. Discover /dev/cu.usbmodem00096003658* and /dev/cu.usbserial-0287A9CA by VID/PID, expose a framed authenticated command/event channel, and route the same action-session ids used by relay jobs over USB when LTE registration is absent. Add a simulator mode that replays UART events without flashing, and make every command idempotent with an expiry and a local receipt.

Create a commitment ledger and event-reconciliation layer separate from ordinary reminders. Normalize a commitment as an obligation with parties, quoted source evidence, created/updated timestamps, due interval, confidence, sensitivity, and lifecycle states (proposed, accepted, fulfilled, superseded, at-risk, expired). Ingest only deltas from pendant speech, authenticated browser mail/forms, Mac calendar/mail/files, and outbound action receipts. Use deterministic evidence rules first, background extraction second, and expose an explanation whenever an item becomes at-risk. Deliver a private review card or short pendant prompt; never send a follow-up automatically.

Add a typed Resume Packet protocol for deferred intentions.
